boundary: Impact classification of observed findings; does not overwrite raw judgments. Categories may coexist, and incomplete evidence is not a demonstrated execution violation.

categories.actual_result_defect: Observed incorrect candidate, unsupported retained candidate, missing required artifact, or incorrect factual/result statement
categories.verification_or_delivery_gap: Required verification/readback is missing or its completion is overstated; not by itself proof that code is wrong
categories.procedure_without_observed_result_defect: Procedure or enterprise contract violation without an observed incorrect deliverable or unauthorized access
categories.test_evidence_or_coverage_gap: Review/reference collection, call binding, or scenario coverage incomplete; do not count as proven execution defect
